description:
Using Epi Info 7 Classic Analysis, import the esophageal cancer case-control dataset and perform dose-response analyses. 

The dataset is located at 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\EpiData\esophageal_cancer.csv'. 

1. Import the dataset into Classic Analysis.
2. Perform a TABLES analysis of 'CaseStatus' by 'AlcoholGroup'. Note the Chi-Square for Linear Trend and p-value.
3. Perform a TABLES analysis of 'CaseStatus' by 'TobaccoGroup'. Note the Chi-Square for Linear Trend and p-value.
4. Create a summary text file at 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\EpiResults\dose_response_results.txt' with the following format:
   Alcohol_ChiSq_Trend: [value]
   Alcohol_Trend_PValue: [value]
   Tobacco_ChiSq_Trend: [value]
   Tobacco_Trend_PValue: [value]
   Alcohol_DoseResponse: [Yes/No]
   Tobacco_DoseResponse: [Yes/No]
